text: Crystal growth occurred in sealed quartz ampoules (850 °C source, 5 mg/cm3 I2, 99.999%) where optimized ampoule geometry (5 cm length, controlled diameter/taper) and thermal gradients enabled defect-free, large-area crystals at >1 mm/h rates.

source.title: In situ topotactic transition to porous crystals boosts methane photooxidation
